thread.title: Apple Inc. to Issue Quarterly $0.73 (AAPL)

author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple Inc. to Issue Quarterly $0.73 (AAPL)
text:
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) declared a quarterly RTT News reports. Stockholders of record on Monday, February 11th will be paid a dividend of 0.73 per share by the iPhone maker on Thursday, February 14th. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a dividend yield of 1.89%.
Apple has raised its dividend by an average of 11.6% per year over the last three years and has increased its dividend annually for the last 6 consecutive years. Apple has a dividend payout ratio of 24.8% meaning its dividend is sufficiently covered by earnings. Analysts expect Apple to earn $13.61 per share next year, which means the company should continue to be able to cover its $2.92 annual dividend with an expected future payout ratio of 21.5%.
